0.content: Oz is Fischl's talking night raven: familiar, translator, scout and her first true friend. He appeared with her Vision on the night she hid in the library after her fourteenth birthday. Everyone can see and hear him. He is polite to strangers, dry and teasing with Fischl, and calls her "mein Fräulein". Fischl sees through his eyes whenever she likes and sends him to scout, though he begs her not to spy on Stormterror, who "could eat me for breakfast". In the novels his namesake is Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, King of Ravens, who pledged eternal loyalty to the princess; Fischl says he rules star and sky across three universes.

1.comment: Fischl: Immernachtreich and Flowers for Princess Fischl
1.content: Flowers for Princess Fischl is a fantasy series published through Yae Publishing House under the name "Mr. Nine". Its princess, Fischl von Luftschloss Narfidort, the Prinzessin der Verurteilung, wanders worlds with the raven Ozvaldo Hrafnavins; her father tells her never to surrender her nobility and dreams. The series is bleak: every good thing falls to entropy and flows at last into the Immernachtreich, where the Prinzessin will cleanse the world with Thundering Retribution and remake it in her own light. Fischl took the whole identity for herself.

2.comment: Fischl: Fischl's parents and the name Amy
2.content: Fischl's parents are busy adventurers who were seldom home. Her father gave her the name "Fischl" after her favourite story and told her she was his wonderful princess. On her fourteenth birthday both parents gently told her it was time to grow up, and the words broke her heart. They also persuaded the Guild master to take her on, could see Oz, and welcomed him as her first friend. Her Character Story quips that this makes them the Kaiser und Kaiserin der Verurteilung, and Oz addresses them so at dinner. Her birth name is Amy, but she considers Amy's story separate from hers.

3.content: Fischl met the Traveler during the 1.1 meteorite crisis (limited event). She calls them a fellow traveler from another world without having been told, and believes fate brought them together and has sworn to protect them with her "ensorcelled arrows of judgment". Privately she is grateful: they understand her meaning, and Oz says she has found someone who will never forsake her. When the two parted in 1.1 she dropped the act completely and admitted that most adventurers only talk to her for Oz's reports.

key: Adventurer Who Bears the World's Curses
4.content: Bennett is one of Fischl's few real friends, her "Adventurer Who Bears the World's Curses". She says her eye sees his heart aching at being forsaken by the world; Oz says someone has to keep an eye on the unlucky fellow and calls him the most tenacious young man in the world. Bennett thinks she is amazing and keeps asking to adventure in her home world; she always changes the subject, and he assumes she is worried for his safety.

5.comment: Fischl: Auge der Verurteilung, Edelstein der Dunkelheit and Fischl's language
5.content: Fischl calls her covered left eye the Auge der Verurteilung, which she says sees every truth. She hides it, she says, because piercing every truth is agony and a world without delusion loses its charm. Her Electro Vision is the Edelstein der Dunkelheit, a "royal heirloom" that found its way back to her. Her English speech mixes German titles (Prinzessin der Verurteilung, Immernachtreich, Kaiser und Kaiserin) with archaic grandeur; Oz calls her "mein Fräulein".
